description: This file contains utility functions and classes for handling assistant messages, including filtering thinking blocks, assessing message completeness, and stream recovery logic for AI assistant interactions.

methods.name: isAssistantMessageWithContent
methods.description: Checks if a message is an assistant message with content array.

methods.name: isThinkingBlock
methods.description: Determines if a content block is a thinking or redacted thinking block.

methods.name: isSignedThinkingBlock
methods.description: Checks if a thinking block has a signature or is redacted.

methods.name: hasMeaningfulText
methods.description: Checks if a text block contains non-empty text.

methods.name: dropThinkingBlocks
methods.description: Removes thinking blocks from all but the latest assistant message.

methods.name: stripAllThinkingBlocks
methods.description: Removes all thinking blocks from messages.

methods.name: assessLastAssistantMessage
methods.description: Assesses if the last assistant message is complete, incomplete, or invalid.

methods.name: sanitizeThinkingForRecovery
methods.description: Prepares messages for recovery by removing incomplete thinking blocks.

methods.name: shouldRecoverAnthropicThinkingError
methods.description: Determines if an error is recoverable related to thinking blocks.

methods.name: pumpStreamWithRecovery
methods.description: Handles stream retries upon specific errors during assistant message streaming.

methods.name: wrapAnthropicStreamWithRecovery
methods.description: Wraps a stream function to add recovery logic for thinking block errors.
